title: JobType
description: The operation a Job carries. This is the DISCRIMINATOR of the job union: job.schema.json binds each job_type to exactly one payload schema, so a Job is never an untyped dictionary. Only operations with an implemented payload schema appear here on purpose — listing a type without a payload contract would let unvalidated payloads through. Each type also has a CLASSIFICATION, which decides how the execution path treats it: 'move_object' is MUTATING (exclusive project lock, recovery point, plan persisted before mutation, verification from the saved file, durable save, preview, derived idempotency key). 'inspect_scene' is READ (no write lock, no recovery point, no save, no preview, naturally idempotent, cacheable). A read that took a write lock and rendered a preview would be both slow and wrong, which is why the classification is part of the contract vocabulary rather than a worker implementation detail. Reserved for future milestones (each needs its own payload schema plus one conditional in job.schema.json before being added): rotate_object, scale_object, set_object_dimensions, set_material_color, create_wall, create_opening, set_light, create_camera, render_preview, save_version.
